certificate: Safety familiarization basic training and instruction for all seafarers

questions.question: If 25% of the crew -or more- has not participated in Fire drill during the last month, what is the time limit to conduct such a drill after the vessel has left a port?

options.B: Within 24 hrs

questions.question: What kind of information must be posted in all passenger cabins?

options.A: Names and ranks of all senior officers on board
options.B: The meal times and daily recreational activities
options.C: Ship’s speed, current location, and weather forecast
options.D: The route to muster station, how to put on lifejacket and different emergency signals used onboard the ship

questions.question: Select emergencies which could lead to fires or the foundering of ships.

options.A: Failure of main steering gear in calm seas
options.B: Minor oil leaks in dry store

questions.question: Select emergencies which could lead to fires or the foundering of ships.

options.B: Shifting of cargo and engine-room explosion or fire

questions.question: How can you avoid and/or reduce potential panic among passengers if a dangerous situation occurs?

options.A: Lock passengers inside their cabins until the situation is resolved
options.B: Sound the abandon ship signal immediately without explanation
options.C: Inform passengers at frequent intervals over the public announcement system about the situation and how they shall act. Use as many of the ship’s officers and crew among the passengers to assist
options.D: Direct all passengers to immediately head to the lifeboats without instructions

questions.question: Where would you find details of your tasks and duties in case of an emergency?

options.B: In the muster list
options.D: In the chief engineer's standing orders

questions.question: How many separate means of escape routes from passengers and crew spaces shall passenger ships carrying less than 36 passengers have? (SOLAS II-2/28)

options.B: Three

questions.question: Emergency instructions in appropriate languages shall be posted in passenger cabins. Which one of the given instructions has to be included according to present SOLAS regulations?

options.A: The contact details of the port authority
options.B: The method of donning lifejackets
options.C: Instructions on how to operate communication radios
options.D: Guidelines on how to deploy liferafts manually

questions.question: If some of the passengers are disabled, i.e. using wheelchair, cane, blind etc., what precaution should the crew take?

options.A: Assign them to the top deck cabins for quicker access
options.B: Instruct them to evacuate ahead of all other passengers automatically
options.C: Ensure they remain in their cabins throughout the entire voyage
options.D: All passengers that will require some form of assistance in case of evacuation, etc. must be registered, so there can be crew sent to assist them if needed

questions.question: If the general/fire alarm is sounding, and evacuation is required, what is the best way to ensure that all passengers are aware of the situation?

options.A: Blowing the ship's horn continuously without giving oral instructions
options.B: Using public announcement system to inform about situation. Inform passengers to report to designated area for head count
options.C: Turning off all power on board to signal immediate action
options.D: Sending crew members to knock on every cabin door individually without using public systems

questions.question: Who usually gives the order to abandon ship?

options.B: Safety Officer

questions.question: What do the letters E.P.I.R.B. stand for?

options.B: Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon

questions.question: What equipment might be used to give Abandon Ship command?

options.B: VHF hand-held radio set on Channel 16 only

questions.question: What is the best posture in the water to reduce your body temperature loss?

options.B: Starfish position

questions.question: What is the best posture in the water to reduce your body temperature loss?

options.B: Horizontal swimmer position

questions.question: Can you drink sea water?

options.B: HELP

questions.question: Using spoken radio communication, what is the code word used to indicate a distress message.

options.B: MAYDAY

questions.question: What are types of lifeboats?

options.A: Fast rescue, slow rescue, and survival craft
options.B: Partially enclosed, self-righting partially enclosed and totally enclosed
options.C: Open wood, steel frame, and fiberglass

questions.question: What number of lifeboats are required on cargo Ship?

options.A: One lifeboat on the stern of the vessel only
options.B: Capacity for 50% on the port side and 50% on the starboard side
options.C: Capacity is twice the number of persons the ship is certified to carry with at least one lifeboat on each side of the ship
options.D: Sufficient capacity for 100% of persons on board placed anywhere

questions.question: What number of lifeboats is required in Passenger Ship?

options.A: Sufficient for the number of persons that the ship is certified to carry
options.B: Exactly 4 lifeboats regardless of passenger count
options.C: Twice the number of total certified capacity
options.D: Enough for 75% of passengers, with liferafts covering the rest

questions.question: What equipment level within a Liferaft is usually referred to?

options.B: “Standard Pack” or “Emergency Pack”

questions.question: What is the minimum number of rescue boats on passenger ships with 500 g.t. and over?

options.A: No rescue boats required if lifeboats are present
options.B: At least 1 rescue boat on any side of the ship
options.C: At least 1 rescue boat on each side of the ship

questions.question: What is the minimum number of rescue boats on passenger ships, less than 500 g.t?

options.A: No rescue boats are mandated below 500 g.t.
options.B: At least 2 rescue boats on each side
options.C: At least 1 rescue boat on both sides
options.D: At least 1 rescue boat on any side of the ship

questions.question: What is the minimum number of rescue boats on cargo ships?

options.A: Cargo ships do not require rescue boats
options.B: At least 1 rescue boat
options.D: 1 rescue boat for every 15 crew members

questions.question: How many Immersion suits should be assigned to the crew of the rescue boat?

options.B: For every person

questions.question: How many immersion suits shall there be on open lifeboats of passenger and cargo ships?

options.B: One for each person on board

questions.question: In fire prevention principles what does STARVATION means?

options.A: Restricting the oxygen flow to the flame source
options.B: Reducing the chemical reaction rate using powder
options.C: Removing the fuel from a fire. It is unable to sustain combustion
options.D: Cooling the temperature below flash point using water

questions.question: In fire prevention principles what does SMOTHERING means?

options.B: Lowering the heat using water mist
options.C: This is achieved by reducing the oxygen (air) surrounding the fire
options.D: Removing combustible material from the room

questions.question: In fire prevention principles what does COOLING means?

options.B: This is usually achieved by using water to reduce the temperature of the burning substance below its ignition temperature
options.C: Eliminating fuel source from surrounding area
options.D: Cutting off oxygen supply with a fire blanket

questions.question: In fire prevention principles what does INTERFERENCE means?

options.A: Depriving the fire of oxygen completely
options.B: Lowering thermal radiation using foam spray
options.C: Washing away the liquid fuel surface
options.D: This is an anti-catalytic effect which breaks the chemical chain reaction that sustains a fire
